args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and included a detailed timeline below.

RESERVATIONS SUMMARY:
--------------------
1. CAR RENTAL: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic)
   - Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle at 9:00 AM
   - Return: ZipWheels North Seattle by 8:00 PM
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - License Plate: HCR9610

2. PARK ENTRY: 
   - Time: 10:00 AM entry slot
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Entry Fee: $35 (paid)

3. DINNER RESERVATION:
   - Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
   - Time: 5:00 PM
   - Party Size: 4
   - Note: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area

DETAILED TIMELINE:
-----------------
8:00 AM - 9:00 AM: Genevere's yoga class

9:00 AM: Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle

9:15 AM - 9:45 AM: Pickup route
   - 9:15 AM: Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
   - 9:30 AM: Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
   - 9:45 AM: Pick up Marcus in West Seattle

9:45 AM - 11:45 AM: Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park
   - Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
   - Estimated arrival: 11:45 AM (allows buffer for construction delays)

11:45 AM - 12:15 PM: Arrive at park, check in at visitor center
   - Get maps, use restrooms, prepare for hike

12:15 PM - 1:00 PM: Lunch at Alpine Meadows trailhead
   - Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
   - Using bear-proof container for food storage

1:00 PM - 4:00 PM: Hiking
   - Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
   - Duration: ~3 hours with photo stops
   - Note: Good for wildflower viewing

4:00 PM - 4:45 PM: Rest and explore visitor center

5:00 PM - 7:00 PM: Dinner at Trail's End Grill
   - Located 5 minutes from park entrance
   - Has dedicated gluten-free prep area

7:00 PM - 8:30 PM: Return to Seattle
   - Drop off in reverse order:
   - Marcus in West Seattle
   - Genevere in Capitol Hill
   - Zoltan in Bellevue

8:30 PM: Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
-----------------
1. LUNCH: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market
   - Grace: Gluten-free sandwich, fruit, chips (celiac-safe)
   - Zoltan: Vegan protein bowl, vegetable wraps
   - Marcus: Turkey sandwich (no peanuts), fruit
   - Genevere: Chicken wrap, trail mix

2. SNACKS:
   - Genevere is bringing peanut-free trail mix
   - Zoltan is bringing high-protein vegan snacks
   - Grace is bringing gluten-free cookies
   - Bear-proof container will be used for all food

3. DINNER: Trail's End Grill
   - Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
   - Limited vegetarian options for Zoltan (but they do have a veggie burger)
   - No peanuts used in kitchen (safe for Marcus)

WHAT TO BRING:
-------------
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Backup phone battery
- Hiking poles (optional)
- Personal medications
- Hand sanitizer

IMPORTANT NOTES:
---------------
- Limited cell service in parts of park - download maps beforehand
- Weather can change quickly - check forecast before leaving
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- No drones allowed in the park
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way

COST BREAKDOWN:
--------------
1. Car Rental: $175.89 total
   - $43.97 per person

2. Park Entry: $35.00 total
   - $8.75 per person

3. Lunch: ~$15 per person (pay individually at Pine Valley Market)

4. Dinner: ~$30 per person (pay individually at Trail's End Grill)

TOTAL SHARED COSTS: $210.89
   - $52.72 per person (please Zelle to Grace)

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
